periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique vertical orientation, approximately 75 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering towards the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated teardrop profile with a high vertical-to-horizontal aspect ratio, significantly taller than wide.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering where the narrowest point extends significantly below the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick lateral bands at the humeral region, comprising roughly 30% of the visible upper torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Large gap between pinnae, approximately equal to the width of the ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Sub-conical with slightly pointed apices rather than perfectly semicircular arcs.

other_distinctive_markers: Maximum mandibular gape revealing full dentition and oral cavity; extensive brown-toned oxidative staining across the ventral abdominal fur and hindquarters.
